_note: v2 hooks for la Rue des Écus (ST_ecus, S03_market), a covered stone arcade on a clear frosty winter day between the Place du Marché and the bank, the buy-sell-pay-lend street (ST_commerce seg001-004). Every hook describes what is actually painted (nothing is written in the paintings): Monsieur Verbe the striped mime acts out each verb; the hand mirror marks the reflexive verbs; beret color = verb group.

fr_acheter_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe BUYS a new pair of SHOES: ah, SHOE-TAY! (ash-TAY).
fr_acheter_verb.why: ah-SHOE-TAY → acheter = to buy (acheter des chaussures). RED beret = regular -er.

fr_couter_verb.hook: 'COO!' gasps Monsieur Verbe at the price tag: how much does this woolly hat COST? (koo-TAY).
fr_couter_verb.why: COO + COST → coûter = to cost (ça coûte cher). RED beret = regular -er.

fr_payer_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe PAYS the chestnut seller with a big coin and punches the air: PAY... YAY!
fr_payer_verb.why: PAY → payer = to pay (payer les marrons). RED beret = regular -er.

fr_preter_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe LENDS his PRETTY scarf to a shivering little girl (pray-TAY).
fr_preter_verb.why: PRETTY → prêter = to lend (prêter son écharpe). RED beret = regular -er. Text pass 2026-10-28: bracketed respelling matched to the card (preh-TAY -> pray-TAY).

fr_degager_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe opens the CAGE and FREES the robin: DE-CAGE-ay! (day-gah-ZHAY).
fr_degager_verb.why: DE-CAGE → dégager = to free, to clear (dégager la route). RED beret = regular -er. Text pass 2026-10-28: bracketed respelling matched to the card (day-ga-ZHAY -> day-gah-ZHAY).

fr_louer_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe RENTS a little sled from the hire hut – just on LOAN (loo-AY).
fr_louer_verb.why: LOAN → louer = to rent, to hire (louer une luge). RED beret = regular -er.

fr_commander_verb.hook: Like a COMMANDER, Monsieur Verbe points and ORDERS from the waiter (koh-mahn-DAY).
fr_commander_verb.why: COMMAND → commander = to order (commander un café). RED beret = regular -er. Text pass 2026-10-28: bracketed respelling matched to the card (ko-mahn-DAY -> koh-mahn-DAY).

fr_vendre_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe the VENDOR SELLS hot roast chestnuts from his cart to a little girl (VAHN-dr).
fr_vendre_verb.why: VENDOR → vendre = to sell (vendre des marrons). PURPLE beret = regular -re.

fr_livrer_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe DELIVERS a parcel by bike, straight into the old man's arms (lee-VRAY).
fr_livrer_verb.why: deLIVER → livrer = to deliver (livrer un colis). RED beret = regular -er.

fr_investir_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe tucks his gold coins into his VEST: in-VEST! (an-ves-TEER).
fr_investir_verb.why: IN-VEST → investir = to invest (investir son argent). GREEN beret = regular -ir.

fr_rembourser_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe drops the coins back into the lady's PURSE: he REIMBURSES her (rahn-boor-SAY).
fr_rembourser_verb.why: REIMBURSE (bourse = purse) → rembourser = to pay back, to refund (rembourser un ami). RED beret = regular -er. Text pass 2026-10-28 (hook lint): respelling (rahm-boor-SAY) -> (rahn-boor-SAY) to match the card.

fr_financer_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe hands a bag of coins to the yarn seller: he FINANCES her stall (fee-nahn-SAY).
fr_financer_verb.why: FINANCE → financer = to fund, to finance (financer un projet). RED beret = regular -er.

fr_depenser_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe SPENDS all his PENNIES: DE-PENNY-SAY, they spill out of his purse (day-pahn-SAY).
fr_depenser_verb.why: PENNY → dépenser = to spend (dépenser son argent). RED beret = regular -er.

fr_emprunter_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe BORROWS a jar of PRUNES from the shop window: em-PRUNE-tay! (ahn-prun-TAY).
fr_emprunter_verb.why: PRUNE → emprunter = to borrow (emprunter un livre). RED beret = regular -er.

fr_piller_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe PILLAGES the coins into a big PILLOWcase sack.
fr_piller_verb.why: PILLOW / PILLAGE → piller = to loot, to plunder (piller un trésor). RED beret = regular -er.

fr_economiser_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe ECONOMIZES: he SAVES a coin in his pink piggy bank (ay-koh-noh-mee-ZAY).
fr_economiser_verb.why: ECONOMIZE → économiser = to save (économiser de l'argent). RED beret = regular -er. Text pass 2026-10-28: bracketed respelling matched to the card (ay-ko-no-mee-ZAY -> ay-koh-noh-mee-ZAY).

fr_ecrier_verb.hook: Mirror in hand, Monsieur Verbe CRIES OUT: 'Ay, CREE-ay!' (ay-kree-YAY).
fr_ecrier_verb.why: a CRY → s'écrier = to cry out, to exclaim (« Bravo ! » s'écria-t-il). Reflexive: the mirror; être in compound tenses. RED beret = regular -er. Text pass 2026-10-28 (hook lint): respelling (ay-kree-AY) -> (ay-kree-YAY) to match the card.

fr_ecouler_verb.hook: Mirror in hand, Monsieur Verbe watches the sand FLOW AWAY through his hourglass, as COOL as can be (ay-koo-LAY).
fr_ecouler_verb.why: a-COOL-ay → s'écouler = to flow out; (time) to pass (le temps s'écoule). Reflexive: the mirror; être in compound tenses. RED beret = regular -er.

fr_accumuler_verb.hook: Snow ACCUMULATES on Monsieur Verbe's beret as he heaps up a bowl of coins (a-kew-mew-LAY).
fr_accumuler_verb.why: ACCUMULATE → accumuler = to pile up, to accumulate (accumuler des pièces). RED beret = regular -er.

fr_revendiquer_verb.hook: Behind the stall, an angry Monsieur Verbe DEMANDS his parcel back: REVENGE-ICK-AY! (ruh-vahn-dee-KAY).
fr_revendiquer_verb.why: REVENGE-ICK → revendiquer = to claim, to demand (revendiquer ses droits). RED beret = regular -er.
